Mr. Vibhor Tewari, learned counsel for the petitioner(s).
2. Mr. Maneesh Bisht and Mr. Hargovind Pant, learned 
B.H.s’ for the State.
3. Petitioner(s) has filed the present petition(s) to implement 
and apply the provisions of Uttarakhand Retirement Benefit 
Act, 2018, particularly Section 7(1) of the said Act considering 
the qualifying service of the petitioner from the date of 
substantive appointment/regularization for determining 
gratuity as prescribed under the said Act and another ancillary 
relief.
4. Learned counsel for the State prays for and is granted six 
weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit(s).
5. List these cases on 22.09.2026.
